result.summary:
INT-auth-session adversary against 30a4065036a917514fb4984fde73f87867f38619 (detached checkout; `git rev-parse HEAD` = 30a4065…). Attack branch devin/pp/adv/auth-session-30a40650 @ 7bd8de384552731b7b46fa3940a5c923da263edb (one commit on top of HEAD_SHA; adds ONLY apps/mobile/__tests__/adv/authSessionAdversary.test.ts (59 tests) and supabase/functions/api/__wf__/xc_adv_auth_session.test.ts (18 tests); `git diff --stat 30a4065..HEAD` = 2 files, 1702 insertions, 0 deletions; no production code, existing test, or migration touched; no PR opened; pushed with a plain `git push -u origin`, no force). attacks_tried = 77 = 59 Jest + 18 Deno tests; 4 REPRO (defect) tests are the confirmed breaks (2 mobile P2, 1 edge P2, 1 edge P3 defense-in-depth); the remaining 73 attacks held.

ATTACK BOUNDARIES PROBED (>=8): (1) refresh rotation races — concurrent route-401 / foreground / explicit triggers; stale 401 for a rotated-away bearer; same refresh token 5x concurrently; spent-token replay. (2) account switch and sign-out mid-refresh — A signs out & B signs in while A's refresh is pending; late rotation after sign-out; sign-out while launch refresh pending. (3) 401/403 vs transient — 400/404/408/409/422/429/500/502/503/504, malformed 200/204 bodies, network error, abort, >15s hang, all retain the session; only 401/403 sign out. (4) expiresAt skew/rollback — past, zero, now, inside 60s lead, inside 5-min foreground lead, fresh; edge clock ±(10min/2h) vs GoTrue; 1-second lifetime; ms-scale expires_at. (5) corrupted persisted state — 20+ malformed Keychain records (non-object, array, wrong version, unknown provider, bad UUID, blank/numeric refresh token, bad generation, __proto__ shapes), Keychain read failure, upper-case UUID, corrupt SQLite restore marker; edge: 11 malformed L2 cache rows + identity-mismatch row + poisoned row of a logged-out session. (6) slow launch refresh → late 401 / late success after the 8s deadline. (7) repeated/double actions & failing storage — single vs double sign-out, Keychain delete failure on sign-out, logout 5xx, logout 404 from GoTrue. (8) token persistence — access/provider tokens never in Keychain, SQLite kv, console, or serialisable store state; Keychain accessibility AFTER_FIRST_UNLOCK_THIS_DEVICE_ONLY. (9) bearer capture — long-lived clients resolve via bearerTokenFor after rotation (held; note DrillLibraryScreen.tsx memoises createTrainingApi({token: session?.bearerToken}) keyed on session.bearerToken — INFERRED to re-memoise on rotation because the store session object is replaced; not proven either way, no break claimed). (10) malformed refresh inputs — undefined/null/''/whitespace/number/bool/array/object/4097-char token, non-JSON / array / scalar bodies → 400 without consulting GoTrue; whitespace trimmed; stray Authorization header ignored. (11) Redis outage — cache/rate-limit backend answering 502 HTML: bearer auth, refresh, logout all still correct.

NON-BREAKING ATTACKS (all VERIFIED; exact commands):
- Mobile adversary suite: `cd apps/mobile && npx jest __tests__/adv/authSessionAdversary.test.ts` → exit 0, 1 suite, 59 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped (55 held + 2 REPRO + 2 contract controls); artifact mobile-adv-run2.log (attachment). Held: concurrent triggers collapse to ONE refresh & never re-present a spent token; stale 401 for rotated bearer ignored; A/B switch mid-refresh isolates bearer, vault, owner; late rotation after sign-out resurrects nothing and relaunch stays signed out; every transient status (400,404,408,409,422,429,500,502,503,504), malformed 200/204, network error, abort, and >15s hang keep the session and retry with the SAME refresh token; 401 and 403 sign out exactly once; past/zero/now/inside-lead expiresAt refresh once (no storm, >=30s gap); foreground refresh inside 5-min lead only; every malformed vault record is cleared and signs nobody in; Keychain read failure leaves record intact and signs nobody out; upper-case UUID normalised; corrupt SQLite marker cannot suppress a valid vault; late 401 after 8s deadline signs out cleanly; late success installs bearer once without re-configuring clients; single sign-out revokes exactly once; Keychain delete failure on sign-out still blocks next-launch restore via SQLite marker; logout 5xx leaves nothing resurrected and app not busy; tokens never reach kv/console/store; Keychain accessibility pinned.
- Edge adversary suite: `cd supabase/functions/api/__wf__ && deno test -A --no-check --config deno.json xc_adv_auth_session.test.ts` → exit 0, 18 passed / 0 failed / 0 ignored (16 held + 2 REPRO); artifact edge-adv-run2.log. Held: logout with rotated-away bearer is 401 and leaves the successor session intact; logout with the NEW bearer kills the rotated refresh token too; 9 malformed refreshToken shapes and 5 malformed bodies → 400 with zero GoTrue calls; whitespace trimmed; stray bearer ignored on refresh; 5 concurrent presentations of one refresh token → exactly ≤1 200, rest 401, no 5xx, winner usable; replay of a spent token → 401 + 1 auth-failure INCR, successor untouched; ms-scale expires_at passes through (characterisation — app clamps); 1s-lifetime session rotates, bearer expires, refresh token still works; edge clock −10min accepts, +2h refuses bearer as expired without asking GoTrue but refresh still rotates; 11 malformed L2 cache rows never 5xx and never change identity; poisoned row for a logged-out session is refused by the revocation fence; Redis answering 502 HTML leaves bearer auth/refresh/logout correct; GoTrue logout 404 → 204 and bearer fenced locally ('The session is no longer valid. Sign in again.').
- Baselines at HEAD_SHA before adding tests: `cd apps/mobile && npx jest __tests__/authDurableSession.test.ts __tests__/sessionKeeperShortLife.test.ts` → exit 0, 24/24 (baseline-mobile.log); `cd supabase/functions/api/__wf__ && deno test -A --no-check --config deno.json auth_session_contract_test.ts xc_adjudicate_auth_refresh.test.ts xc_adjudication_auth.test.ts` → 30 passed / 0 failed (baseline-edge.log; shell exit code not captured in that log — the same files re-ran green inside the full `deno task test` below).
- test-authentication skill gate 1 (mobile) + adversary file: `cd apps/mobile && npx jest --ci __tests__/adv/authSessionAdversary.test.ts __tests__/authDurableSession.test.ts __tests__/authHydrateRestore.test.ts __tests__/authStore.test.ts __tests__/accountBootstrap.test.ts __tests__/wf/be-auth-session-lifecycle.test.ts __tests__/wf/flow-sign-in-auth.test.tsx __tests__/wf/SignInScreen.buttons.test.tsx __tests__/wf/be-mobile-security-secrets.test.ts __tests__/launchGate.test.ts __tests__/onboardingScreen.test.tsx __tests__/sessionKeeperShortLife.test.ts` → exit 0, 12 suites / 228 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped (mobile-auth-gate.log). SKIPPED / NOT RUN: skill gate 3 `./supabase/tests/run_rls_tests.sh` (RLS matrix) — not run; outside the auth-session attack surface (DB isolation is another area) and Docker Hub pulls are rate-limited on this VM. UNKNOWN, not a pass.

NOT_YET_VERIFIABLE (Mac/device only; no verdict guessed): real Keychain behaviour under AFTER_FIRST_UNLOCK_THIS_DEVICE_ONLY across device restart/before-first-unlock, real process death + relaunch, real Sign in with Apple/Google token exchange against a Supabase project, and background-suspend timer behaviour. Command a Mac run would need: `scripts/mac-full-verify.sh` on the M4 runner (NOT `--remote` from Linux; the runner is coordinator-owned), then a human step on the simulator: sign in with a Sandbox Apple Account → kill app → relaunch (must stay signed in) → Settings → Sign out twice quickly, and inspect the Supabase Auth sessions for that test user (never the production project ucqnaiwqwjtgvlduiuib with real accounts). Whether real GoTrue's 10s refresh-token reuse interval returns the same session for the concurrent-refresh case (the harness spends immediately) is UNKNOWN.

SEVERITY RATIONALE: the three sign-out breaks are not P0 — the device deletes its vault first, so the surviving server session is reachable only by someone who already exfiltrated the refresh token; but 'explicit sign-out revokes THIS device's session' is a documented supported path (AGENTS.md, authDurableSession pin) that fails on repeated taps, slow launch refresh, and lapsed bearers → P1-borderline, reported P2 because no data/money is lost and the session expires naturally. The cache-identity break needs Redis write access → P3 defense-in-depth. Deviation from .agents/skills/test-authentication 'extend authDurableSession.test.ts, no parallel harness': the task mandates new files under __tests__/adv/ and forbids editing existing tests, so a self-contained harness was written there instead.
